verdict.rationale: Books is confirmed as a double-entry accounting system with journal entries as a core capability ("writing journal entries" is explicitly listed as a task Command can help with), implying balanced debit/credit posting, but there's no direct documentation of a manual journal-entry UI, memo/note fields, or debit=credit validation for accountant-initiated entries — most journal entry evidence frames it as an AI-assisted/automated task rather than manual accountant entry. Missing for 10: explicit manual entry screen documentation, memo/attachment support on journal entries, and confirmation of balance validation.
